verifications.claim: The 98th Academy Awards (2026) will air live on ABC on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'ABC, which broadcasts the Oscars'; multiple mentions of 'Sunday, March 15, 2026'. R3: 'this year's Oscars will be broadcast once again on ABC from 4 p.m. PT / 7 p.m. ET on Sunday, March 15.'
verifications.reasoning: Both references directly confirm ABC broadcast and exact date.

verifications.claim: The 98th Academy Awards (2026) will start at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '7 p.m. Eastern, 4 p.m. Pacific'. R3: '7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT'.
verifications.reasoning: Exact times match in both references.
